description_en: Queries the external identity provider bound to a specified workspace. Each workspace can be bound to at most one external identity provider, so the response returns at most one record. Application secret configurations are not returned
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间已绑定的外部身份提供商。每个工作空间最多绑定一个外部身份提供商，因此响应最多返回一条记录。应用密钥类配置不会返回
name: ListIdentityProviders

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1~100。不指定该参数时默认返回 10 条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, specify the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标。首次调用不指定该参数，后续调用指定上一次返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

items.description_en: The list of external identity providers

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted according to RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_en: The event subscription callback URL. Configure this URL in the external identity provider application to receive organization change events. An empty string is returned if the user pool has not been provisioned
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_zh: 事件订阅回调地址。需要将该地址配置到外部身份提供商的应用中用于接收组织变更事件，用户池尚未开通时返回空字符串

identityProviderType.description_en:
The type of the external identity provider. Valid values:
DingTalk
Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

loginCallbackUrl.description_en: The logon callback URL. Configure this URL in the external identity provider application. An empty string is returned if the user pool has not been provisioned
loginCallbackUrl.description_zh: 登录回调地址。需要将该地址配置到外部身份提供商的应用中，用户池尚未开通时返回空字符串

loginEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether workspace users are allowed to log on through this external identity provider
loginEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录

metadata.description_en: The application configuration of the external identity provider. Application secret configurations are not returned
metadata.description_zh: 外部身份提供商的应用配置。应用密钥类配置不会返回

appId.description_en: The App ID of the Lark application. Required when the binding type is Feishu
appId.description_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填

appKey.description_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. Required when the binding type is DingTalk
appKey.description_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填

corpId.description_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk enterprise. Required when the binding type is DingTalk
corpId.description_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填

status.description_en:
The binding status. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration has been accepted and is waiting for user pool provisioning.
SYNCING: Organization members are being synchronized.
SYNCED: Organization member synchronization is complete.
READY: The binding is active.
SYNC_FAILED: Organization member synchronization failed.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
UPDATE_FAILED: The configuration update failed.
DISCONNECTING: The binding is being removed.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: The unbinding failed
status.description_zh: 绑定状态。可选值：CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）

syncEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether organization member synchronization is enabled. When enabled, organization members are synchronized from this external identity provider as workspace users
syncEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户

updatedAt.description_en: The last modification time in UTC, formatted according to RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page that takes effect for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询生效的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is empty if no more pages exist
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。没有下一页时为空

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of external identity providers that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的外部身份提供商总数
